summary: The no_valid_comparison closure stands. All 40 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all four numerical claims reproduced. The paper reports selected gene directions in P21 males but leaves its handling of siblings unspecified. The corrected proposal removes the claim that the authors treated offspring as independent and allows reopening for a documented, compatible litter-level analysis. The verdict also records that publisher.html contains only a redirect.
openIssues: No inspected author result establishes gene-level effects or inference for the registered comparison of three litters per arm.
The first author’s dissertation download returned HTTP 403. Only its public abstract could be reviewed.
